description: This file defines the interface class ISessionServerManager for managing session server operations in the Rialto media server component. It declares virtual methods for initialization, configuration, state management, logging, and ping functionality, and includes necessary headers and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: ISessionServerManager
classes.description: An interface class for managing session server lifecycle, configuration, and communication.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server with command-line arguments.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration parameters for the session server, including socket name, state, resource capabilities, display name, and permissions.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the current state of the session server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Configures log levels for various components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Performs a health check or keep-alive by sending a ping with an acknowledgment sender.
